class {{class_name}}:
    def __init__(self, k):
        self.buf = [None]*k
        self.k = k
        self.head = 0
        self.size = 0
    def enqueue(self, x):
        if self.size == self.k: return False
        self.buf[(self.head + self.size) % self.k] = x
        self.size += 1
        return True
    def dequeue(self):
        if self.size == 0: return None
        v = self.buf[self.head]
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.k
        self.size -= 1
        return v
